title: Description List
summary: Description list component for displaying key-value pairs with PDP styling.
shortDescription: The Description List component renders key-value pairs in a semantically correct definition list format. Styled to match the product detail page patterns, it presents attribute labels alongside their values in a consistent layout. Ideal for displaying product specifications, order details, account information, or any structured data where items have descriptive labels. Supports various layouts including horizontal, vertical, and grid arrangements.
